owner_decisions.decision: Owner-requested UI change round 3 (WP5-UX3) before pilot activation; the English item list U-01..U-27 is in handoff/delivery/tasks/WP5-UX3-PLAN.md. Summary: stop enforcing the industrial style standard and use a modern style (governance text in AGENTS.md); more contrast between the page background and cards/panels/sheets, the week sheet raised (shadow); a top-bar identity block (right-aligned avatar; display name in bold over a smaller email, right-aligned before it) that opens a menu with the Light/Dark toggle, Profile, Settings (the Settings and Admin main-menu items move there; Administration becomes a tab or sub-page of Settings) and Sign out; on large screens the wordmark visible, Check in/out with its since-time on the page-title row, no user name under the title, distinct 'old'/'current'/'future' pills (future pink) in both themes, one wrapping row for payroll date, due and zone, 'Open a day' beside its date picker, space between Show details and Change several days, the editor column marked by a Day-cell fill and differently coloured rails, batch-selected columns and the editor column lifted by a soft shadow (the editor column also with a thin blue focus border), and answers on the row names 'Label' and 'Check'; on narrow screens 'Current' when the three period buttons still do not fit, and the 'Open a day' text hidden when its row does not fit; in the Day editor a short (or no) zone note, a stronger panel header, new/edit time sessions in a separate dialog with the panel listing times and a break table (start date, start time, minutes), a clear delete confirmation, defaults from Settings and suggested breaks pre-filled for past days, a simpler break area (one 'Confirm no breaks taken' checkbox, one row per break, Suggest breaks and Add break), Save also confirming with a confirmation prompt before Save and before Cancel with changes, and WFH on the Label row. Business behaviour changes only where the owner's words require it (break confirmation through Save); any canonical rule this touches is flagged and updated under AGENTS rule 8.

documented: Deny and ask permission rules are evaluated before the classifier; an ask rule forces a prompt even in auto mode.

The classifier reads 'autoMode' configuration only from user settings (~/.claude/settings.json), managed settings or --settings/SDK; not from project .claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.local.json.
Subagents inherit the main session's auto mode; a frontmatter permissionMode is ignored when the main session is in auto mode.
The classifier reads the user's messages and the commands run, not their output.
A user message that names the action and its specific danger can clear a soft-deny block for that one action; naming the verb alone does not.
The /permissions 'Recently denied' retry is a one-off terminal UI approval (terminal dialogs are not available in this desktop session).
inferred_or_unknown: The 'Credential Leakage' rule wording is not published.
Whether a subagent's classifier sees the main conversation's user messages is not stated explicitly; the earlier 'Instruction Poisoning' case cleared after the owner's direct message.

coordinator_constraints: Agents change no permission or global settings (AGENTS rule 3); any settings change is the owner's own action.
